newsitem.title: USA: Hercules Inc says exchange rates hurt Q2.
newsitem.headline: Hercules Inc says exchange rates hurt Q2.

text.p: Hercules Inc said on Thursday that although it recorded stronger volumes in all its continuing businesses during the second fiscal quarter, unfavorable exchange rates had taken a bite out of profits.

"We were pleased to see stronger volumes in all our continuing businesses, even though this positive impact on sales was offset by a 5 percent negative impact from changes in rates of exchange, mostly in western Europe," said Chief Executive Keith Elliott.

The company, which makes chemicals and solid fuel systems, posted 1997 second quarter earnings of $75 million, or $0.75 per share, compared with 1996 net income of $88 million, or $0.81 per share. Hercules said the latter per-share figure included a net nonrecurring gain of $0.05.
